guides.title: Find your way around
guides.summary: Home, search, the menu and help.
steps: **Home** is your to-do list. Each tile shows contracts waiting for you; click one to open them.
**Urgent** lists notice deadlines that have passed or are due within a week, each with what to do.
Click **Search** or press Ctrl+K to find any contract or supplier by name, reference or SAP number.
Use the menu to move around: **Contracts**, **Renewals** and **Suppliers**.
Click **?** beside any page title for help with that screen, or open **Help** from the menu.

guides.title: Raise a contract
guides.summary: Start a draft with just a title, and fill in the rest as you go.
steps: Go to **Contracts** and click **Add contract**.
Type a **Title**, for example "Linen hire 2027".
Choose the **Supplier**, then the **Category**: its **Family**, then **Category**, and a **Subcategory** if you like (or type a word to find it). Supplier not there yet? Click **Add new supplier**.
Add the value, dates and notice period if you know them. Only a title is needed for a draft; the rest is checked when you send it on.
Leave **Needs Legal review** ticked unless Legal has agreed it doesn't need one.
Click **Save draft**. The contract gets its reference, for example JBSAUS0000416.

guides.title: Add a document or a new version
guides.summary: Attach drafts, mark-ups and signed copies; replace a file without losing the old one.
steps: Open the contract and scroll down to **Documents**.
Choose the **Kind**, for example Draft or Signed copy.
Click **Add document** and choose the file: PDF, Word, Excel, Outlook email, text or an image, up to 25 MB.
To replace a document but keep the earlier one, click the **new version** button beside it. Every version stays in the history.

guides.title: Find a contract
guides.summary: Search, filters and the key date.
steps: Go to **Contracts**. **My contracts** shows the ones you own or back up; **All** shows every contract you can see.
Type in the search box: a title, a reference such as JBSAUS0000412, a supplier or an SAP number.
Click **Filters** to narrow the list, for example to one site or supplier.
The **Key date** is the notice deadline if there is one, otherwise the end date. It turns amber within 30 days and red once it has passed.

guides.title: Withdraw a contract that isn't going ahead
guides.summary: Close it off with a reason. Nothing is deleted.
steps: Open the contract. You can withdraw it from Draft, Legal review or Signing.
Scroll to the bottom and click **Withdraw this contract**.
Say why it isn't going ahead, then confirm. It moves to Closed and keeps its history.

guides.title: Send a contract to Legal
guides.summary: Hand it over, then pick it up again when Legal sends it back.
steps: Open your draft and click **Send to Legal**.
Add a note for Legal if it helps, and attach the files they should look at.
Click **Send to Legal**. Legal is emailed, and the progress bar shows it's Legal's turn.
When Legal sends it back, it shows on your Home under **Back from Legal**. Make the changes, then send it to Legal again.

guides.title: Review a contract (Legal)
guides.summary: Pick it up, go back and forth with the owner, and clear it.
steps: On Home, **New to pick up** lists contracts waiting for Legal. Open one.
Click **I'll take it**. It's yours now, and the owner can see who has it.
Click **Update status** to show you're reviewing it or waiting on the supplier.
Need something from the owner? Click **Send to owner** and say what's needed.
When you're happy, click **Legal cleared** and write a short outcome. It moves to Signing.

guides.title: Send a signed contract for approval
guides.summary: Attach the signed copy and the effective date.
steps: Sign the contract in DocuSign as usual. In JBS Contracts it shows as Signing.
Open the contract and click **Send for approval**.
Attach the **Signed copy** and enter the **Effective date**. The date is required and never filled in for you.
Click **Send for approval**. The Group Head and approvers are emailed.

guides.title: Add the SAP outline agreement number
guides.summary: Add it when you send for approval, or any time after, without a Variation.
steps: If you have the number when you send for approval, type it in the **SAP outline agreement number** box there. It's optional.
Otherwise open the contract once it's signed: in **Value**, click **Add** next to SAP outline agreement number.
Type the number and click **Save**. To fix one, click **Change**; leave it empty to clear it.
It's a reference, not a term, so it changes even on an Effective contract without a Variation. Each change shows in Activity.

guides.title: Approve a contract (on your phone or computer)
guides.summary: Check the signed copy matches, then approve and register it.
steps: Open the link in the email, or **To approve** on Home, and choose the contract.
Check the details, then open the signed copy and check it matches.
Something not right? Click **Send back** and say what needs fixing. It goes back to the owner.
All good? Click **Approve and register**, then confirm. It becomes Effective and locked, and you're back on Home.
Approved by mistake? Click **Undo** in the message, or **Undo approval** on the contract, within 24 hours.

guides.title: Record a renewal decision
guides.summary: Renew, let it end or renegotiate, before the notice deadline.
steps: Go to **Renewals**. Overdue notice deadlines are at the top.
Click **Record decision** on a contract.
Choose **Renew**, **Let it end** or **Renegotiate**, and add a short note.
Click **Save decision**. The reminder emails for it stop. Renew starts a new draft linked to this contract.

guides.title: Mark a review done
guides.summary: For contracts with a review date, such as evergreen ones.
steps: Open the Effective contract and click **Review done**.
Add a short note and, if it needs another review, the next review date.
Click **Save**. Review reminders start again from the new date.

guides.title: Change an Effective contract with a Variation
guides.summary: Dates, value and more change only once the Variation is approved.
steps: Open the Effective contract and click **Start a Variation**.
Say why it's changing, then click **Start**.
Change what's needed: now and new sit side by side. Click **Save changes**.
Send it to Legal if it needs a review, then **Send for approval**. Nothing changes on the contract until it's approved.

guides.title: Hand over a contract
guides.summary: Change the owner or backup at any time.
steps: Open the contract and click **Hand over**.
Choose the new **Owner** and, if you like, a **Backup**.
Click **Hand over**. They're emailed, and it's recorded in Activity.

guides.title: Fix a mistake on a locked contract (admins)
guides.summary: An emergency unlock of up to 4 hours, for what a Variation can't fix.
steps: Use this only for a mistake, such as a mistyped supplier name. Real changes go through a Variation.
Open the contract and click **Emergency unlock**.
Say why, choose how long (1 to 4 hours), and confirm. A banner shows while it's unlocked, and only admins can edit.
Fix the mistake, then click **Lock it again now**. Every edit records the unlock and its reason.

guides.title: Set up a supplier's details
guides.summary: Relationship owner, tier, risk, next business review and contacts.
steps: Go to **Suppliers** and click the supplier's name.
On **Overview**, click **Edit**. Choose the **Relationship owner** and the **Tier**.
Set the **Risk** and say why, and when the **Next business review** is due. Click **Save details**.
Click **Add contact** to add someone at the supplier, with their role, email and phone.

guides.title: Add a supplier document
guides.summary: Insurance, certificates and the like, with an expiry date and an optional reminder.
steps: Open the supplier and choose **Documents**, then **Add document**.
Choose the **Kind**, choose the file and, if it expires, the date. Click **Upload**.
Tick **Remind me before it expires** to get an email 60 and 30 days before. Anyone can tick it for themselves.
When a renewed one arrives, click **New version** and give its new expiry date. The earlier version is kept.

guides.title: Record a business review
guides.summary: Who attended, a summary, ratings, the actions agreed and the deck.
steps: Open the supplier and choose **Business reviews**, then **Add business review**. Procurement, admins and the supplier's relationship owner can.
Enter when it was held and who attended from JBS. Tick the supplier's people, or click **Add new contact**. Then write a short summary.
Give an overall rating, and score quality, delivery, service and cost from 1 to 5.
Click **Add an action** for each thing agreed: what, who (someone at JBS, or the supplier) and when. Then set when the next review is due.

Click **Add review**, then **Attach a file** for the deck or minutes. **Word** and **Print** give you the review as minutes. JBS people with an action are emailed; the supplier's actions show on the relationship owner's Home.

guides.title: Print or download the register
guides.summary: Choose your columns and filters, then print to PDF or download Excel.
steps: Go to **Reports**. The **Register** lists every Effective contract.
Click **Columns** and tick what you want to see. Your choice is kept for next time.
Click **Filters** to narrow it down, for example to one business unit.
Click **Print or save as PDF** for a clean printout, or **Download Excel** for every column.

guides.title: See what your team has coming up
guides.summary: Who has what overdue, coming up and on their turn.
steps: Go to **Team**. Each person shows what's overdue, coming up, on their turn and waiting on others.
Choose how far ahead to look: 30, 60, 90 or 180 days.
Click a person to see each contract, how long it has waited and its supplier and value.
Click a contract to open it.

guides.title: Download everything
guides.summary: A full copy of the records in one Excel workbook, and every document as a ZIP.
steps: Go to **Reports** and choose **Download everything**.
Click **Download everything** for one workbook with a sheet each for contracts, documents, Legal review, approvals, Variations, reminders, suppliers, people and lists.
Admins can also click **Download all documents** for a ZIP of every file, in a folder per contract.
Both downloads are recorded in the audit trail. Keep the files somewhere safe.

guides.title: Give someone access
guides.summary: Add a person and tick what they can do.
steps: Go to **People** and click **Add person**.
Type their **Windows logon**; the domain is filled in for you.
Add their name and work email. Reminders and approvals go there.
Tick what they can do, then click **Add person**. They're emailed a welcome.

guides.title: Add a contract field
guides.summary: Ask for something new on every contract, without any code.
steps: Go to **Contract fields** and click **Add field** under the right section.
Type the **Label**, choose the **Kind of field**, and add help if it's useful.
Choose where it shows (the Contracts list, Excel) and whether it changes only through a Variation.
Click **Add field**, check the preview, then **Save changes**. Nothing changes for anyone until you save.

guides.title: Change a reminder or email
guides.summary: Wording and days, with a live preview and history.
steps: Go to **Emails and reminders** and open the email to change.
For a reminder, set the **Days before** and click **Save days**.
Change the subject or wording. Click a placeholder such as {Reference} to add it.
Check the preview, then click **Save wording**. Every change is kept in the history.

guides.title: Import old contracts and their files
guides.summary: From a Medius export or any spreadsheet: match the columns, check, import, then add the files from ZIPs.
steps: Go to **Import old contracts** under Admin and click **Choose the spreadsheet** (or drag it onto the box): Excel or CSV, one contract per row.
Check where each column goes. Old reference, title, supplier, category and owner are needed; you can choose a default owner and category for rows without one.
Click **Check (nothing changes yet)**. Each row shows whether it goes in as Effective or Ended, is already there, or can't be imported and why.
Click **Import** and confirm. Current contracts become Effective and locked with their original dates; expired ones Ended.

Then add their files: choose (or drag in) the ZIPs, as many as you like, or drag in the whole folder of them. Each file is matched by the old or JBSAUS reference in its name, its folder or the ZIP's name. What each file is (signed copy, draft, variation, cover page) comes from words in its folder or name; change any that are wrong, then click **Add files**.

guides.title: Add or change many at once with Excel
guides.summary: People, lists, suppliers and contracts, previewed before anything changes.
steps: Click **Export to Excel** on the page. The file is also the template for importing.
Change or add rows in Excel. Blank cells leave what's there; nothing is deleted.
Click **Import from Excel** and choose the file.
Check what will be added, changed or not imported (and why), then click **Import** (it says how many rows).
